# Rare Earth Projects

> Rare Earth Projects (Rarearth Projects Private Limited) is a land developer in Bengaluru (Bangalore), Karnataka, India, established in 2022. It develops gated villa-plot and plotted communities in north Bengaluru: near Nandi Hills, in Devanahalli, Bagalur and Yelahanka, near SLK Tech Park and off Bellary Road. Montira and Athena are registered with Karnataka RERA.

## Selling now
- [Montira](https://www.rareearthprojects.com/projects/montira/): 116 villa plots on 14.35 acres at Chikkasagarahalli, Nandi Hobli, at the foothills of Nandi Hills. 229 date palms, four parks (about 21% of the site) and an 18,000 sq ft resort-style clubhouse. Plots from ₹1.12 Cr (indicative; registration and other charges extra). Karnataka RERA PRM/KA/RERA/1254/460/PR/160525/007750.
- [Athena](https://www.rareearthprojects.com/projects/athena/): 110 plots in two phases on about 6.4 acres at Jonnahalli, Devanahalli Taluk, near the KIADB Aerospace, Hardware and Tech Parks next to the airport. Phase II is selling; Phase I is sold out and completes in December 2026. Plots of 30 × 40 ft, 30 × 50 ft and corner plots up to 2,300 sq ft. Prices on request. Karnataka RERA PRM/KA/RERA/1250/303/PR/181225/008351.

## Sold out
- [Serenity](https://www.rareearthprojects.com/projects/serenity/): gated, approved plotted community at M. Hosahalli, Bagalur, off the Whitefield–Airport Road near the KIADB Aerospace & Software Park.
- [Tranquility](https://www.rareearthprojects.com/projects/tranquility/): 24 gated premium sites at Singanayakanahalli, Yelahanka.
- [Arcadia](https://www.rareearthprojects.com/projects/arcadia/): approved, DC-converted residential sites at Poojanahalli, next to SLK Tech Park, within BIAAPA limits.
- [Elysia](https://www.rareearthprojects.com/projects/elysia/): 35 residential sites at Kadiganahalli, about 300 m off Bellary Road (NH-44).
